topic: set up automatic bill pay to avoid late fees
core_question: How do I set up automatic bill payments so I don't miss due dates?
answer_summary: Log into each biller's account or your bank's bill pay portal and enroll the account in automatic payments, linking a checking account, and set a reminder to ensure sufficient funds before each due date.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; texting quickly with typos here and there
